summary: Provide schema mapping and on-demand evidence export for organizational activity ledger and legal attestation
description:
Issue summary: Customer requests a one-off export and schema mapping for the 'organizational activity ledger' (their term for per-tenant audit events) plus a signed attestation that the export matches Redwood's canonical audit chain.

Impact: MapleBank needs the export and attestation to complete an internal compliance review and provide evidence to their regulator. Missing or mismatched fields will delay their audit window and could trigger legal follow-up.

Customer ask: 1) A compact schema CSV that maps Redwood audit fields to MapleBank's SIEM columns including pseudonymization/pseudonym salt fields and HMAC envelope mapping. 2) An on-demand export of a timebound ledger slice (2026-02-01 to 2026-02-10) in compressed JSONL + manifest with per-file SHA256 and a signed manifest (RSA-2048). 3) A short signed attestation document stating the export was generated from the canonical audit service and describing the retention window and KMS key used to sign.

Deadline: Customer requests delivery by 2026-02-25 COB.

Desired deliverables: field_map.csv, ledger_slice_20260201-20260210.jsonl.gz, manifest_20260201-10.sig, attestation_map_signed.pdf, and a short runbook describing replay steps for forensic playback.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Customer ran a local mapping test against the sample schema we provided previously and reported 3 missing fields (tenant_role, request_origin, session_id_hash).
2) Customer attempted to ingest sample JSONL into their SIEM and saw schema mismatch errors on tenant_role and session_id_hash.
3) Customer raised this ticket and attached their ingest error logs.
logs_excerpt:
[2026-02-19T14:12:03Z] ingest-error: missing_field tenant_role for event_id 7f3a9c
[2026-02-19T14:12:04Z] ingest-error: invalid_format session_id_hash for event_id 7f3a9c
[2026-02-19T14:12:05Z] export-request: user=compliance@maplebank.com range=2026-02-01/2026-02-10 format=jsonl
investigation_summary: Preliminary triage by Support found that the exported sample set from 2026-01 contained tenant_role under a nested 'context' object which our canonical export flattens to tenant_role at top-level for production exports. session_id_hash is present but is HMAC-SHA256 with per-tenant salt; customer expected a stable pseudonym without tenant-level rotation. Hypothesis: their ingest expects a deterministic pseudonym seed and cannot handle rotation. Also observed the customer's SIEM field names differ (e.g., 'src_ip' vs our 'request_origin').
comments: [2026-02-20] Aisha Kaur (Support): Created ticket after call with MapleBank. Attached their ingest error log and their compliance questionnaire PDF.

[2026-02-21] Daniel Ortiz (SRE): Confirmed canonical export format for org activity ledger. Will generate a field_map.csv mapping Redwood fields to customer SIEM fields; will include notes on pseudonym rotation and HMAC scheme.

[2026-02-22] MapleBank (customer): Thanks — can you also include the exact KMS key ID used to sign the manifest and whether a signed timestamp (RFC3161) can be included? Need those for legalchain evidence.

[2026-02-23] Daniel Ortiz (SRE): We can include the KMS key fingerprint and produce an RFC3161 timestamp on the manifest. Preparing export; will provide a sample 10-event slice for approval before delivering full range.

[2026-02-24] Aisha Kaur (Support): Uploaded draft field_map.csv to ticket and shared sample 10-event slice at https://s3.redwood.ai/secure/tmp/SUP-953782/sample-10.jsonl.gz (expiring link). Requested confirmation of tenant_role semantics from customer.
[2026-02-25] MapleBank: Confirmed sample looks correct for tenant_role and session_id_hash format. Approved full export and attestation.
resolution_notes: Planned actions: 1) Produce full ledger slice (2026-02-01 to 2026-02-10) as compressed JSONL and generate manifest with per-file SHA256 and an RFC3161 timestamp signed with KMS key 'projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/audit/cryptoKeys/exporter-key/cryptoKeyVersions/1'. 2) Produce field_map.csv documenting source field, transformation applied (HMAC salt + algorithm), SIEM target column, and example values. 3) Draft attestation signed by Security Manager and provide follow-up runbook for replay/playback. Export scheduled for 2026-02-25 16:00 UTC.
